sentences.en: Sami accused Layla of throwing a brick through his window.
sentences.zh: 萨米指控莱拉向他的窗户扔了一块砖。

sentences.en: This kung fu master can break bricks with his hands.
sentences.zh: 这位功夫大师可以用手碎裂砖块。

sentences.en: Giving advice to him is like talking to a brick wall.
sentences.zh: 给他提建议就像跟一堵墙说话一样。

senses.zh: 砖，砖块；砖形物；[口]心肠好的人 -
用砖做的；似砖的 形容词: bricky
